threeChamber.tagline: 社交偏好与社交新颖性 · 鼻尖嗅探判定
threeChamber.summary: 实验鼠在三个相连的箱室中自由探索，两侧各放一个铁丝杯。社交偏好阶段一侧杯内是陌生鼠，另一侧为空杯或物体；社交新颖性阶段一侧是熟悉鼠，另一侧换成新的陌生鼠。经典读数是各箱室的停留时间和对两个杯子的嗅探时间。
threeChamber.whyPose: 质心追踪只能判断动物在哪个箱室。真正的社交接触是鼻尖贴近杯子并朝向它。RodentFlow 用鼻尖到杯子的距离加头朝向判定嗅探，并排除爬到杯子上的帧，更接近人工计分。
setup_zh: 标定四个角点并输入三箱内部尺寸
把 L / R 手柄拖到两个铁丝杯的中心
在参数里选择陌生鼠（或新陌生鼠）所在的一侧
setup_en: Calibrate four corners and enter the three-chamber arena dimensions.
Drag L / R handles to the centers of the two wire cups.
Select the side containing the stranger (or novel stranger) in parameters.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心所在箱室（左 / 中 / 右）的累计时间与进入次数。
measures.def_en: Cumulative time and entries for the left, center and right chambers based on the body center.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖在杯子外缘 2 cm 以内、头朝向杯子（±45°），且身体中心不在杯子上。
measures.def_en: Nose within 2 cm of the cup perimeter, oriented toward it (±45°), with the body center off the cup.

measures.def_zh: (社交 − 物体) ÷ (社交 + 物体)，按嗅探时间计算；新颖性阶段为 (新 − 熟悉) ÷ (新 + 熟悉)。
measures.def_en: (Social − object) / (social + object), based on investigation time; novelty phase uses (novel − familiar) / (novel + familiar).

measures.def_zh: 首次嗅探每个杯子的时间、嗅探回合数。
measures.def_en: Latency to first investigation of each cup and number of investigation bouts.

refs.citation: Moy SS et al. (2004) Sociability and preference for social novelty in five inbred strains: an approach to assess autistic-like behavior in mice. Genes Brain Behav 3:287–302.
Yang M, Silverman JL, Crawley JN (2011) Automated three-chambered social approach task for mice. Curr Protoc Neurosci 8.26.

threeChamber.tagline_en: Sociability and social novelty · Nose-point investigation
threeChamber.summary_en: A test mouse explores three connected chambers with wire cups in the side chambers. In the sociability phase, one cup holds a stranger and the other is empty or contains an object; in social novelty, a familiar mouse is contrasted with a new stranger. Readouts include chamber dwell times and cup investigation.
threeChamber.whyPose_en: Centroid tracking shows chamber position, not investigation. RodentFlow combines nose-to-cup distance and head orientation, excluding frames with the body on the cup, to approximate manually scored cup investigation.

socialInteraction.tagline: 慢性社会挫败后的社交回避 · SI ratio
socialInteraction.summary: 慢性社会挫败应激（CSDS）模型的标准读数。实验鼠在旷场中探索两次，每次 150 s：第一次网罩内为空（无目标），第二次放入陌生的攻击鼠（有目标）。比较两次在网罩周围互动区的停留时间，SI ratio < 1 通常归为易感。
socialInteraction.whyPose: 除了身体中心在互动区的时间，RodentFlow 还给出鼻尖在网罩附近的嗅探时间，帮助区分主动探索和路过；同一只鼠的两个阶段会自动配对，计算 SI ratio。
setup_zh: 标定旷场四角，选择网罩靠在哪面墙
无目标、有目标两个阶段分别建立分析，编号相同即可自动配对
setup_en: Calibrate the open-field corners and specify the enclosure wall.
Analyze target-absent and target-present phases separately under the same subject ID to pair results automatically.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在网罩周围互动区（默认 26 × 14 cm）内的时间。
measures.def_en: Time the body center spends in the interaction zone around the enclosure (default 26 × 14 cm).

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在网罩对侧两个角落区（默认 9 × 9 cm）内的时间。
measures.def_en: Time spent in two opposite corner zones (default 9 × 9 cm each).

measures.def_zh: 有目标阶段互动区时间 ÷ 无目标阶段互动区时间（同一编号自动配对）。
measures.def_en: Interaction-zone time with target / without target (sessions with matching subject IDs are paired).

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖在网罩外缘 2 cm 以内并朝向网罩的时间。
measures.def_en: Time with the nose within 2 cm of the enclosure edge and facing it.

refs.citation: Golden SA, Covington HE, Berton O, Russo SJ (2011) A standardized protocol for repeated social defeat stress in mice. Nat Protoc 6:1183–1191.
Krishnan V et al. (2007) Molecular adaptations underlying susceptibility and resistance to social defeat in brain reward regions. Cell 131:391–404.

socialInteraction.tagline_en: Social avoidance after chronic social defeat · SI ratio
socialInteraction.summary_en: A standard readout for chronic social defeat stress (CSDS). The mouse explores an open arena in two 150 s trials: first with an empty enclosure, then with an unfamiliar aggressor behind it. Interaction-zone dwell time is compared; SI ratio < 1 is commonly used as a susceptibility cutoff.
socialInteraction.whyPose_en: Beyond body-center dwell time in the interaction zone, RodentFlow estimates nose-based enclosure investigation to help distinguish active approach from passing. Two phases with the same subject ID are paired for SI ratio.

dyadicSocial.tagline: 两只自由活动小鼠 · 鼻对鼻、肛殖区嗅探、跟随
dyadicSocial.summary: 两只小鼠在同一场地自由互动，例如青少年社交、居住者-入侵者测试中的非攻击部分、雌雄互动。读数是各类嗅探与跟随行为的时间和次数。
dyadicSocial.whyPose: 社交接触由身体部位之间的距离定义：鼻尖–鼻尖、鼻尖–尾根（肛殖区）、鼻尖–身体。这需要每只鼠的多个关键点，用质心无法区分。
setup_zh: 两只鼠毛色、体型或标记不同时，身份判定最可靠；体色相同时，行走时体长和活动量的稳定差异也会被利用，但最可靠的仍是做标记（尾部记号笔条纹或背部染色）
识别时会自动开启双鼠模式，建议逐帧识别
在回看中先看“疑似交换”，再按“身份待核对”逐个检查，A / B 不对时点“从这里交换 A / B”
setup_en: Identity is most reliable when the mice differ in fur colour, size or marks; for mice of the same colour, consistent differences in body length while walking and in activity are also used, but marking them (marker-pen stripes on the tail or a dyed patch on the back) remains the most reliable
Two-mouse detection is enabled automatically; detecting every frame is recommended
In the review, check “Likely swap” first, then step through “Check identity”; if A / B are wrong, tap “Swap A / B from here”

measures.def_zh: 两只鼠鼻尖距离 < 2.5 cm。
measures.def_en: Distance between noses < 2.5 cm.

measures.def_zh: 一只鼠的鼻尖到另一只鼠尾根 < 2.5 cm（A→B、B→A 分开统计）。
measures.def_en: Nose-to-tail-base distance < 2.5 cm, reported separately for A→B and B→A.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖到对方身体中心 < 3 cm，且不属于上面两类。
measures.def_en: Nose-to-partner body center < 3 cm, excluding the two categories above.

measures.def_zh: 间距 < 15 cm，两鼠速度都 > 5 cm/s，跟随者朝向对方（±45°）且持续 ≥ 0.5 s。
measures.def_en: Distance < 15 cm; both speeds > 5 cm/s; follower oriented toward partner (±45°) for ≥ 0.5 s.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心距离的平均值，以及 < 10 cm 的近距离时间。
measures.def_en: Mean body-center distance and time spent within 10 cm.

refs.citation: Segalin C et al. (2021) The Mouse Action Recognition System (MARS) software pipeline for automated analysis of social behaviors in mice. eLife 10:e63720.
Hong W et al. (2015) Automated measurement of mouse social behaviors using depth sensing, video tracking, and machine learning. PNAS 112:E5351–E5360.

dyadicSocial.tagline_en: Two freely moving mice · Nose-to-nose, anogenital sniffing, following
dyadicSocial.summary_en: Two freely moving mice interact in one arena, for example in juvenile social interactions, nonaggressive resident–intruder behavior or male–female interaction. Readouts include sniffing and following bouts and duration.
dyadicSocial.whyPose_en: Social contacts are defined using landmark distances: nose-to-nose, nose-to-tail-base (anogenital) and nose-to-body. These cannot be distinguished from centroids alone.

residentIntruder.tagline: 攻击潜伏期、次数、时长 · 追逐、压制、威胁、骑跨
residentIntruder.summary: 把一只陌生的 intruder 放进 resident 的饲养笼，通常观察 10 min。读数是攻击潜伏期、攻击次数和时长，以及追逐、压制、威胁姿势和骑跨等攻击相关行为；嗅探和跟随作为非攻击性社交一并给出。
residentIntruder.whyPose: 攻击的特征在运动学里：resident 突然加速扑向对方（接近速度骤升），接触后两鼠高速、方向混乱地翻滚，随后 intruder 逃离或被追逐。RodentFlow 用每只鼠的颈到尾根距离作为体长，以体长为单位计算距离和相对速度，判定攻击、扭打、追逐、压制、侧身威胁、直立和骑跨；不需要标定场地。
setup_zh: 开始录像后再放入 intruder：放入前只有 resident 的画面用来自动确定谁是 resident 和放入时间
必须逐帧识别（一次扑击只有 100–200 ms），帧率 ≥ 25 fps
两只鼠毛色或体型不同、或给 intruder 做标记时，身份最可靠
回看中核对“攻击”时间轴，必要时在参数中调整阈值
setup_en: Start recording before introducing the intruder: footage with only the resident is used to identify the resident and the introduction time automatically
Detect every frame (a lunge lasts only 100–200 ms), at ≥ 25 fps
Identity is most reliable when the mice differ in coat or size, or when the intruder is marked
In the review, check the “Attack” timeline; adjust the thresholds in the parameters if needed

measures.def_zh: 从 intruder 放入到首次攻击的时间（s）；没有攻击时记为测试时长。
measures.def_en: Time from the intruder's introduction to the first attack (s); the test duration when there was no attack.

measures.def_zh: 两鼠贴近、高速且方向混乱的打斗片段（不区分发起者）：次数、总时长、平均时长；扭打（原地翻滚）单独给出。
measures.def_en: Episodes where the mice are in contact and move fast in changing directions (initiator not judged): count, total and mean duration; clinch (rolling in place) reported separately.

measures.def_zh: 追逐、压制、侧身威胁、攻击性直立的总时长，与攻击本身分开。
measures.def_en: Total duration of chasing, keep down, lateral threat and aggressive upright, separate from attacks.

measures.def_zh: 每次测试给出“发生攻击”（0 / 1）；汇总表中一组的平均值 × 100。
measures.def_en: Each test reports “Attack occurred” (0 / 1); the group mean × 100 in the summary table.

measures.def_zh: 肛殖区嗅探、鼻–鼻接触、跟随（不能单独算作攻击）；骑跨单独统计。
measures.def_en: Anogenital sniffing, nose-to-nose contact, following (not counted as aggression on their own); mounting is counted separately.

refs.citation: Koolhaas JM, Coppens CM, de Boer SF, Buwalda B, Meerlo P, Timmermans PJA (2013) The resident-intruder paradigm: a standardized test for aggression, violence and social stress. J Vis Exp 77:e4367.
Segalin C et al. (2021) The Mouse Action Recognition System (MARS) software pipeline for automated analysis of social behaviors in mice. eLife 10:e63720.
Hong W et al. (2015) Automated measurement of mouse social behaviors using depth sensing, video tracking, and machine learning. PNAS 112:E5351–E5360.

residentIntruder.tagline_en: Attack latency, bouts, duration · chasing, keep down, threat, mounting
residentIntruder.summary_en: An unfamiliar intruder is placed into the resident's home cage, usually for 10 min. Readouts are attack latency, attack bouts and duration, and aggression-related behaviors such as chasing, keep down, threat postures and mounting; sniffing and following are reported as non-aggressive social behavior.
residentIntruder.whyPose_en: Attacks have a kinematic signature: the resident suddenly accelerates toward the other mouse (approach speed jumps), the pair then tumbles fast and in changing directions, and the intruder flees or is chased. RodentFlow uses each mouse's neck → tail base distance as its body length, computes distances and relative speed in body lengths, and scores attacks, clinch, chasing, keep down, lateral threat, upright postures and mounting; no arena calibration is needed.

headDirection.tagline: HD 细胞记录配套 · 头朝向占据与角速度
headDirection.summary: 记录头朝向细胞（ADN、后下托、压后皮层等）时，需要每一帧动物头部在环境中的朝向，以及每个方向上的停留时间（占据），用来归一化调谐曲线；角速度（AHV）用于分析 AHV 细胞和调谐的速度依赖性。
headDirection.whyPose: 传统方法要在头上装两个 LED。RodentFlow 用两耳中点 → 鼻尖的向量估计头朝向（鼻尖缺失时用颈部 → 鼻尖），不需要标记物，并输出带时间戳的逐帧 HD 和 AHV，可直接与电生理或钙成像数据对齐。
setup_zh: 可选：把 Q 手柄拖到墙上的提示卡，作为参考方向
记录系统与视频的同步偏移需自行对齐（导出 CSV 含逐帧时间戳）
setup_en: Optional: drag Q to a wall-mounted cue card to set the direction reference.
Align any recording-to-video timestamp offset yourself; CSV exports include frame timestamps.

measures.def_zh: 两耳中点 → 鼻尖向量的方向；0° = 画面右方（或提示卡方向），逆时针为正。
measures.def_en: Direction of the ear-midpoint-to-nose vector; 0° is image right (or cue direction), counterclockwise positive.

measures.def_zh: 每 6° 一格的停留时间，用于归一化调谐曲线。
measures.def_en: Dwell time in 6° direction bins for tuning-curve normalization.

measures.def_zh: 停留时间 ≥ 1 s 的方向格所占比例。
measures.def_en: Fraction of direction bins with dwell time ≥ 1 s.

measures.def_zh: HD 占据分布的平均向量长度，越接近 0 越均匀；偏大时调谐曲线容易受采样偏差影响。
measures.def_en: Mean vector length of head-direction occupancy; values nearer zero indicate more uniform sampling.

measures.def_zh: 头朝向对时间的导数（°/s），以及顺 / 逆时针转头时间。
measures.def_en: Derivative of head direction over time (°/s) and duration of clockwise/counterclockwise turning.

refs.citation: Taube JS, Muller RU, Ranck JB (1990) Head-direction cells recorded from the postsubiculum in freely moving rats. I. J Neurosci 10:420–435.
Peyrache A, Lacroix MM, Petersen PC, Buzsáki G (2015) Internally organized mechanisms of the head direction sense. Nat Neurosci 18:569–575.
Mathis A et al. (2018) DeepLabCut: markerless pose estimation of user-defined body parts with deep learning. Nat Neurosci 21:1281–1289.

headDirection.tagline_en: Head-direction physiology · Direction occupancy and angular velocity
headDirection.summary_en: Recording head-direction cells (e.g., ADN, postsubiculum, retrosplenial cortex) requires framewise head orientation and directional occupancy to normalize tuning curves. Angular head velocity (AHV) supports AHV-cell analyses and speed-dependent tuning studies.
headDirection.whyPose_en: Traditional head-direction tracking may use two LEDs on the head. RodentFlow estimates direction from the ear midpoint → nose vector (fallback neck → nose) without markers, and exports timestamped HD and angular head velocity for alignment with electrophysiology or calcium imaging.

spatialExploration.tagline: 占据图、覆盖度与速度 · 神经记录同步
spatialExploration.summary: 位置细胞、网格细胞记录通常让动物在开放场地中觅食数十分钟。分析放电野之前要先看占据是否均匀、覆盖度是否足够，并按速度阈值（如 > 2 cm/s）去掉静止时段。
spatialExploration.whyPose: 身体中心比质心更稳定（不受尾巴影响），同时还能得到头朝向，便于做位置 × 方向的联合分析。逐帧导出位置、速度和 HD。
setup_zh: 长时间记录可在设置中选择每 2–3 帧识别一次，以节省时间
setup_en: For long recordings, process every 2nd or 3rd frame to save time.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在每个 2.5 cm 方格中的停留时间。
measures.def_en: Body-center dwell time in each 2.5 cm spatial bin.

measures.def_zh: 停留 ≥ 0.2 s 的方格占场地方格的比例，以及随时间的增长曲线。
measures.def_en: Fraction of spatial bins with ≥ 0.2 s occupancy, plus its growth over time.

measures.def_zh: 速度 > 2 cm/s 的时间比例（放电野分析常用的速度筛选）。
measures.def_en: Fraction of time at > 2 cm/s (a common velocity filter for place-field analysis).

measures.def_zh: 总路程、平均运动速度、速度分布。
measures.def_en: Total path length, mean movement speed and speed distribution.

refs.citation: O'Keefe J, Dostrovsky J (1971) The hippocampus as a spatial map. Brain Res 34:171–175.
Hafting T, Fyhn M, Molden S, Moser MB, Moser EI (2005) Microstructure of a spatial map in the entorhinal cortex. Nature 436:801–806.

spatialExploration.tagline_en: Occupancy, coverage and speed · Neural recording alignment
spatialExploration.summary_en: Place-cell and grid-cell experiments often record animals for tens of minutes in open arenas. Before estimating firing fields, inspect occupancy uniformity and coverage and remove immobile periods using a speed threshold such as > 2 cm/s.
spatialExploration.whyPose_en: Body-center position is less sensitive to tail movements than an image centroid. Together with head direction, it supports position × direction analyses and framewise export of position, speed and HD.

openField.tagline: 运动与焦虑样行为 · 中央区、转圈、静止
openField.summary: 最常用的自发活动与焦虑样行为测试：动物在方形或圆形场地中自由探索 5–30 min，读数包括总路程、中央区时间和进入次数。
openField.whyPose: 用身体中心代替质心（不受尾巴影响），另外还能得到按身体轴向计的转圈数、静止时间和身体伸展程度。
setup_zh: 中央区默认为场地边长的 50%，可在参数中调整
setup_en: The default center region spans 50% of the arena side length; adjust in parameters.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心的移动距离（m）和平均速度。
measures.def_en: Body-center path length (m) and mean speed.

measures.def_zh: 中央区时间 %、进入次数、首次进入潜伏期。
measures.def_en: Percent center time, entries and first-entry latency.

measures.def_zh: 关键点运动 < 1 cm/s 持续 ≥ 1 s 的时间。
measures.def_en: Duration of keypoint movement < 1 cm/s sustained for ≥ 1 s.

measures.def_zh: 按身体轴向累计的完整顺时针 / 逆时针转圈数。
measures.def_en: Full clockwise / counterclockwise rotations accumulated from body orientation.

refs.citation: Prut L, Belzung C (2003) The open field as a paradigm to measure the effects of drugs on anxiety-like behaviors: a review. Eur J Pharmacol 463:3–33.
Seibenhener ML, Wooten MC (2015) Use of the open field maze to measure locomotor and anxiety-like behavior in mice. J Vis Exp 96:e52434.

openField.tagline_en: Locomotion and anxiety-like behavior · Center, turning, immobility
openField.summary_en: The open-field test is a widely used measure of spontaneous locomotion and anxiety-like behavior. The mouse freely explores a square or circular arena for 5–30 min; readouts include total distance, center time and center entries.
openField.whyPose_en: Using the body center reduces tail-related centroid bias, while body heading and length enable rotations, immobility and elongation estimates.

elevatedPlusMaze.tagline: 开放臂探索 + 探头 + 伸展评估姿势
elevatedPlusMaze.summary: 两条开放臂与两条闭合臂交叉的高架迷宫，通常测 5 min。开放臂时间和进入次数比例越低，焦虑样行为越强。
elevatedPlusMaze.whyPose: 风险评估行为——探头（头伸出开放臂边缘向下看）和伸展评估姿势（身体拉长、后肢不动地向前探）——能提供开放臂时间之外的信息，但只能靠鼻尖位置和身体长度来判断。
setup_zh: 依次拖动 C（中心）和 N / E / S / W 四个臂末端
选择开放臂方向（南北或东西）
四周留出空间，让探头时鼻尖仍在画面内
setup_en: Place C at the center and N / E / S / W at the four arm tips.
Select the open-arm axis (north–south or east–west).
Leave enough margin so the nose remains visible during head dips.

measures.def_zh: 开放臂时间 ÷（开放臂 + 闭合臂时间）。
measures.def_en: Time in open arms / time in open plus closed arms.

measures.def_zh: 开放臂进入 ÷ 总进入；默认身体中心和尾根都进入臂才算。
measures.def_en: Open-arm entries / total entries; by default body center and tail base must enter an arm.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖伸出开放臂边缘且身体仍在迷宫上（≥ 0.2 s）；身体在中央区或闭合臂时为受保护探头。
measures.def_en: Nose beyond the open-arm edge while body remains on the maze (≥ 0.2 s); protected when body is in the center or closed arm.

measures.def_zh: 身体长度 ≥ 中位数的 1.2 倍且身体中心速度 < 5 cm/s，持续 ≥ 0.5 s。
measures.def_en: Body length ≥ 1.2× median and body-center speed < 5 cm/s for ≥ 0.5 s.

refs.citation: Pellow S, Chopin P, File SE, Briley M (1985) Validation of open:closed arm entries in an elevated plus-maze as a measure of anxiety in the rat. J Neurosci Methods 14:149–167.
Walf AA, Frye CA (2007) The use of the elevated plus maze as an assay of anxiety-related behavior in rodents. Nat Protoc 2:322–328.
Holly KS, Orndorff CO, Murray TA (2016) MATSAP: an automated analysis of stretch-attend posture in rodent behavioral experiments. Sci Rep 6:31286.

elevatedPlusMaze.tagline_en: Open-arm exploration, head dips and stretch-attend posture
elevatedPlusMaze.summary_en: An elevated maze with two open and two closed arms, commonly tested for 5 min. Reduced open-arm time and entry fractions are often interpreted as more anxiety-like behavior.
elevatedPlusMaze.whyPose_en: Risk-assessment behaviors such as head dips and stretch-attend posture may provide information beyond open-arm time. Estimating them requires nose location and body length rather than centroid position alone.

elevatedZeroMaze.tagline: 开放段时间 + 内外缘头探 + 闭合段探出与伸展评估
elevatedZeroMaze.summary: 环形高架平台分成四段等长的区段：两段相对的闭合段有墙，两段开放段没有墙。没有高架十字迷宫的中央区，动物可以不间断地绕圈探索，常测 5 min。开放段时间比例和头探越少、闭合段内的伸展评估越多，焦虑样行为越强；重复测试时比高架十字迷宫更稳定。
elevatedZeroMaze.whyPose: 所在段按身体中心的方位角判断，可要求尾根也进入（近似四爪进入）。头探要求鼻尖越出跑道内缘或外缘而身体留在开放段；闭合段探出是身体和尾根留在闭合段、只把鼻尖伸进开放段；伸展评估姿势用鼻尖–尾根长度。这些都要把鼻尖和身体分开判断，质心法做不到。
setup_zh: 拖动 C（中心）和 R（外缘）标定圆环，输入外径和跑道宽度
把 O 手柄拖到任一开放段的中点，确定四段的方向
放入时把小鼠放在开闭段交界处、面朝闭合段；“分析时长”常用 300 s
四周留出空间，让头探时鼻尖仍在画面内
setup_en: Drag C (center) and R (outer edge) to calibrate the ring; enter the outer diameter and the track width
Drag the O handle onto the middle of either open segment to orient the four segments
Place the mouse at an open–closed boundary facing the closed segment; the analysis length is typically 300 s
Leave room around the maze so that the nose stays in the image during head dips

measures.def_zh: 开放段时间占分析时间的比例；进入按身体中心（默认加尾根）判断。
measures.def_en: Share of the analysis time in the open segments; entries by the body center (by default with the tail base).

measures.def_zh: 开放段 / 闭合段进入次数、开放段进入比例、首次进入开放段潜伏期、开闭段转换次数。
measures.def_en: Open / closed segment entries, share of open entries, latency to the first open entry, open–closed transitions.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在开放段，鼻尖越出跑道内缘或外缘 ≥ 1 cm，持续 ≥ 0.2 s；内缘、外缘分别计数。
measures.def_en: Body center in an open segment and the nose ≥ 1 cm beyond the inner or outer edge for ≥ 0.2 s; inner and outer counted separately.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心和尾根在闭合段，鼻尖越过边界进入开放段，持续 ≥ 0.2 s，随后退回（紧接着进入开放段的不计）。
measures.def_en: Body center and tail base in a closed segment with the nose across the boundary in an open segment for ≥ 0.2 s, then withdrawn (an immediate entry is not counted).

measures.def_zh: 身体长度 ≥ 中位数的 1.2 倍且身体中心速度 < 5 cm/s，持续 ≥ 0.5 s；另给在闭合段朝向开放段的次数。
measures.def_en: Body length ≥ 1.2 × median with body-center speed < 5 cm/s for ≥ 0.5 s; also counted from a closed segment toward an open one.

refs.citation: Shepherd JK, Grewal SS, Fletcher A, Bill DJ, Dourish CT (1994) Behavioural and pharmacological characterisation of the elevated \u{201C}zero-maze\u{201D} as an animal model of anxiety. Psychopharmacology 116:56–64.

Braun AA, Skelton MR, Vorhees CV, Williams MT (2011) Comparison of the elevated plus and elevated zero mazes in treated and untreated male Sprague-Dawley rats: effects of anxiolytic and anxiogenic agents. Pharmacol Biochem Behav 97:406–415.
Tucker LB, McCabe JT (2017) Behavior of male and female C57BL/6J mice is more consistent with repeated trials in the elevated zero maze than in the elevated plus maze. Front Behav Neurosci 11:13.
Holly KS, Orndorff CO, Murray TA (2016) MATSAP: an automated analysis of stretch-attend posture in rodent behavioral experiments. Sci Rep 6:31286.

elevatedZeroMaze.tagline_en: Open-segment time + inner / outer head dips + closed-segment peeks and stretched attend
elevatedZeroMaze.summary_en: An elevated ring divided into four equal segments: two opposite closed segments with walls and two open ones without. There is no center zone as in the plus maze, so the animal can explore without interruption; usually 5 min. Less open-segment time and fewer head dips, and more stretched-attend postures from the closed segments, indicate more anxiety-like behavior; repeated tests are more consistent than in the plus maze.
elevatedZeroMaze.whyPose_en: The segment is judged by the angle of the body center, optionally also requiring the tail base (≈ four-paw entry). Head dips need the nose beyond the inner or outer edge while the body stays in an open segment; closed-segment peeks are the nose reaching into an open segment while the body and tail base stay closed; stretched attend uses the nose–tail-base length. All of these need the nose and the body judged separately, which a centroid cannot do.

lightDark.tagline: 明箱时间、穿梭 + 探头风险评估
lightDark.summary: 明亮的大箱与黑暗的小箱通过小门相连，测 5–10 min。明箱时间和穿梭次数反映焦虑样行为。
lightDark.whyPose: 身体留在暗箱、只把头伸进明箱的“探头”是典型的风险评估行为，需要把鼻尖和身体分开判断。
setup_zh: 标定整个箱体，再设置明箱所在侧和所占比例
setup_en: Calibrate the full chamber, then set the light compartment side and fraction.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在明箱内的时间比例。
measures.def_en: Fraction of time the body center is in the light compartment.

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在明暗箱之间的穿越次数。
measures.def_en: Number of body-center crossings between light and dark compartments.

measures.def_zh: 首次进入明箱、首次进入暗箱的时间。
measures.def_en: Time to first entry into the light and dark compartments.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖进入明箱而身体中心和尾根仍在暗箱，持续 ≥ 0.2 s。
measures.def_en: Nose enters the light compartment while body center and tail base remain dark for ≥ 0.2 s.

refs.citation: Bourin M, Hascoët M (2003) The mouse light/dark box test. Eur J Pharmacol 463:55–65.
Takao K, Miyakawa T (2006) Light/dark transition test for mice. J Vis Exp (1):e104.

lightDark.tagline_en: Light-compartment time, transitions and head pokes
lightDark.summary_en: The light–dark box has bright and dark compartments linked by a doorway, commonly tested for 5–10 min. Light-side time and transitions are measures of anxiety-like behavior.
lightDark.whyPose_en: A head poke—nose into the light compartment while the body remains in the dark—is a risk-assessment behavior requiring separate nose and body landmarks.

noveltySuppressedFeeding.tagline: 进食潜伏期（人工确认、截尾）· 接近食物 · 家笼摄食对照
noveltySuppressedFeeding.summary: 禁食（常为 24 h）后的小鼠被放进明亮的新环境，中央放一粒食物。新环境抑制进食，首次咬食的潜伏期反映焦虑样行为，慢性（而非急性）抗抑郁药会缩短它。截止时间常为 10 min；测试后立即测家笼 5 min 摄食量和体重下降，排除食欲差异。
noveltySuppressedFeeding.whyPose: 标准视频追踪只知道动物在哪里，分不出“到了食物旁”和“开始吃”。RodentFlow 用鼻尖到食物的距离自动给出接近潜伏期和次数，把“鼻尖在食物区、身体几乎不动、持续数秒”标为候选进食放到回看时间轴上；首次进食由你在回看中确认，未确认的结果不进入组间统计。
setup_zh: 标定整个场地，把 F 手柄拖到食物中心
“分析起点”设为放入场地的时刻，“分析时长”设为截止时间（常用 600 s）
分析后在回看中按“设为首次进食”确认第一口，或“确认截止前未进食”
在参数里填写家笼 5 min 摄食量和禁食前、测试前体重，作为饥饿对照
setup_en: Calibrate the whole arena and drag the F handle onto the food
Set the analysis start to the moment the mouse is placed in the arena and the length to the cut-off (typically 600 s)
After the analysis, confirm the first bite in the review (“Set as first bite”) or “No feeding before the cut-off”
Enter the 5-min home-cage food intake and the weights before the fast and on the test day in the parameters as the hunger control

measures.def_zh: 放入到首次咬食的时间，在回看中人工确认；截止前没吃记为截止时间并标为未进食（右删失），组间页用生存分析。未确认时不进入组间统计。
measures.def_en: Time from placement to the first bite, confirmed by hand in the review; no bite before the cut-off is set to the cut-off and flagged as not eaten (right-censored), analysed with survival analysis on the group page. Unconfirmed sessions do not enter group statistics.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖首次进入食物区（默认半径 3 cm）的潜伏期、进入次数和停留时间。
measures.def_en: Latency of the first nose entry into the food zone (radius 3 cm by default), number of entries and time there.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖在食物区、身体中心速度 < 2 cm/s，持续 ≥ 3 s；标在回看时间轴上，供确认第一口。
measures.def_en: Nose in the food zone with body-center speed < 2 cm/s for ≥ 3 s; marked on the review timeline to find the first bite.

measures.def_zh: 家笼 5 min 摄食量（g）与禁食引起的体重下降 %，可作为协变量。
measures.def_en: Home-cage food in 5 min (g) and weight loss from the fast (%), usable as covariates.

refs.citation: Samuels BA, Hen R (2011) Novelty-suppressed feeding in the mouse. In: Gould TD (ed) Mood and Anxiety Related Phenotypes in Mice II. Neuromethods 63:107–121.
Santarelli L et al. (2003) Requirement of hippocampal neurogenesis for the behavioral effects of antidepressants. Science 301:805–809.
Dulawa SC, Hen R (2005) Recent advances in animal models of chronic antidepressant effects: the novelty-induced hypophagia test. Neurosci Biobehav Rev 29:771–783.
Kaplan EL, Meier P (1958) Nonparametric estimation from incomplete observations. J Am Stat Assoc 53:457–481.

noveltySuppressedFeeding.tagline_en: Latency to feed (confirmed, censored) · approach · home-cage control
noveltySuppressedFeeding.summary_en: After food deprivation (usually 24 h) the mouse is placed in a brightly lit novel arena with a pellet in the center. Novelty suppresses feeding; the latency to the first bite reflects anxiety-like behavior and is shortened by chronic (not acute) antidepressants. The cut-off is usually 10 min; home-cage food intake over 5 min right after the test and the weight loss rule out appetite differences.
noveltySuppressedFeeding.whyPose_en: Standard video tracking only knows where the animal is and cannot tell reaching the food from eating it. RodentFlow measures the approach from the nose–food distance, marks “nose at the food, body almost still for a few seconds” as candidate feeding on the review timeline, and lets you confirm the first bite in the review; unconfirmed results do not enter group statistics.

visualCliff.tagline: 首次选择 · 深侧时间 · 边缘探头
visualCliff.summary: 透明玻璃（或透明底）盖住整个场地：一侧图案紧贴玻璃下方（浅侧），另一侧图案远在下方（深侧），看起来像一个落差。小鼠从中间的平台或中性区出发，有深度知觉的小鼠多选浅侧、少去深侧。表型筛查版（JAX）在透明底的旷场里录 20 min，另报前 4 min。读数为首次选择、深 / 浅侧时间、进入深侧的潜伏期和边缘探头。
visualCliff.whyPose: 所在侧按身体中心判断，可要求尾根也越过分界（卡在中间板边上时不会来回误计）。身体还在中央或浅侧、只把鼻尖伸向深侧的“边缘探头”是典型的风险评估，只有把鼻尖和身体分开判断才能计数。
setup_zh: 标定玻璃面（或透明底）四角，输入内部尺寸
在参数里选择深侧，设置中间板（中性区）的位置和宽度
把小鼠放在中间板上；“分析起点”设为放下的时刻
棋盘格背景和玻璃反光可能影响识别：先看检出率和回看
setup_en: Calibrate the four corners of the glass (or clear floor) and enter the inside dimensions
Choose the deep side in the parameters and set the position and width of the center board (neutral zone)
Place the mouse on the center board; set the analysis start to the moment it is put down
A checkerboard background and reflections on the glass can affect detection: check the detection rate and the review first

measures.def_zh: 离开中性区后先进入的一侧（深侧 = 100，浅侧 = 0；组平均即先选深侧的比例，组间页另给 Fisher 精确检验），以及离开中性区的潜伏期。
measures.def_en: The side entered first after leaving the neutral zone (deep side = 100, shallow side = 0; the group mean is the percentage choosing the deep side first, and the group page adds a Fisher's exact test), and the latency to leave the neutral zone.

measures.def_zh: 深侧、浅侧和中性区的时间（%）与路程；前一段时间（默认 4 min）另算。
measures.def_en: Time (%) and distance on the deep side, on the shallow side and in the neutral zone; an early window (4 min by default) is reported separately.

measures.def_zh: 进入次数和首次进入潜伏期；没有进入时记为截止时间并标为未进入（右删失），组间页给生存分析。
measures.def_en: Number of entries and latency to the first entry; without an entry the latency is the cut-off and flagged as not entered (right-censored), with a survival analysis on the group page.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖伸进深侧，而身体中心和尾根仍在中性区或浅侧，持续 ≥ 设定时长：次数、时间、首次潜伏期。
measures.def_en: The nose over the deep side while the body center and tail base stay in the neutral zone or on the shallow side for ≥ the set time: count, time, latency to the first dip.

refs.citation: Fox MW (1965) The visual cliff test for the study of visual depth perception in the mouse. Anim Behav 13:232–233.
Gibson EJ, Walk RD (1960) The \u{201C}visual cliff\u{201D}. Sci Am 202:64–71.
Kaplan EL, Meier P (1958) Nonparametric estimation from incomplete observations. J Am Stat Assoc 53:457–481.

visualCliff.tagline_en: First choice · time on the deep side · edge head dips
visualCliff.summary_en: A sheet of clear glass (or a clear floor) covers the whole arena: on one side a patterned surface lies directly under the glass (shallow side), on the other it lies far below (deep side), so there appears to be a drop. The mouse starts from a center board or neutral zone in the middle; mice with depth perception mostly choose the shallow side and avoid the deep side. The phenotyping version (JAX) records 20 min in an open field with a clear floor and also reports the first 4 min. Readouts are the first choice, time on the deep / shallow side, the latency to enter the deep side and edge head dips.
visualCliff.whyPose_en: The side is judged by the body center, optionally also requiring the tail base across the boundary (so a mouse sitting on the edge of the center board is not counted as switching back and forth). An “edge head dip”—the body still in the middle or on the shallow side and only the nose reaching over the deep side—is typical risk assessment, and it can only be counted when the nose and the body are judged separately.

marbleBurying.tagline: 埋住的珠子数（按每颗珠子被盖住的程度）· 埋珠事件 · 接近珠子
marbleBurying.summary: 约 5 cm 厚的平整垫料上排列 20 颗玻璃珠，小鼠单独待 30 min（也有 15 或 20 min），结束时数被垫料盖住（常用标准：2/3 以上）的珠子。常用于强迫样、重复性挖掘行为和抗焦虑药筛选，但它到底测什么仍有争议。RodentFlow 在视频里逐颗读取珠子被盖住的程度，结合追踪只在小鼠离开后取样，得到每颗珠子何时被埋，并给出接近珠子的次数和时间。
marbleBurying.whyPose: 珠子是否被盖住要在小鼠不挡住它时才看得清。RodentFlow 用小鼠的关键点（含沿身体轴推算的尾巴位置）判断哪颗珠子此刻没被挡住、小鼠已经离开至少 1 s，只用这些时刻的画面读取珠子的遮盖程度；同一组关键点还给出鼻尖接近每颗珠子的次数和时间。
setup_zh: 相机固定在笼子正上方，整个测试期间不要移动，光照保持不变
把 1–4 号手柄拖到四个角上珠子的中心，在参数里输入行列数和珠子直径；各珠子的圆圈应落在珠子上
“分析起点”设为放入小鼠的时刻；放入前的画面最适合做参照，若没有，会用分析起点时的画面
珠子和垫料颜色反差越大越好
setup_en: Fix the camera directly above the cage, do not move it during the test, and keep the lighting constant
Drag handles 1–4 onto the centers of the four corner marbles, and enter the numbers of rows and columns and the marble diameter in the parameters; each marble's circle should sit on the marble
Set the analysis start to the moment the mouse is put in; footage from before that makes the best reference, otherwise the frames at the analysis start are used
The stronger the colour contrast between marbles and bedding, the better

measures.def_zh: 分析时间段结束时，可见面积被盖住 ≥ 阈值（默认 2/3）的珠子数和比例；同时给出 ≥ 1/2 和几乎全埋（≥ 95%）的数目。
measures.def_en: Number and percentage of marbles with ≥ the threshold (2/3 by default) of their visible area covered at the end of the analysis window; the numbers ≥ 1/2 covered and almost fully buried (≥ 95%) are also given.

measures.def_zh: 每颗珠子 c = (m − m0) ÷ (b − m0)：m 为珠子圆内平均亮度，m0 为参照帧中的值，b 为珠子外一圈垫料此刻的亮度。0 = 和开始时一样，1 = 看起来已和垫料相同。只在小鼠离开该珠子 ≥ 1 s 且没有挡住它时取样。
measures.def_en: Per marble, c = (m − m0) ÷ (b − m0): m is the mean brightness inside the marble's circle, m0 its value in the reference frame and b the current brightness of a ring of bedding around the marble. 0 = as at the start, 1 = looks the same as the bedding. Sampled only when the mouse has been away from the marble for ≥ 1 s and is not blocking it.

measures.def_zh: 小鼠离开某颗珠子后，它的遮盖程度比上一次上升 ≥ 0.2：次数、首次埋珠潜伏期、每 5 min 的埋住数曲线。
measures.def_en: After the mouse leaves a marble, its covered fraction has risen by ≥ 0.2 since the previous reading: count, latency to the first buried marble, and a curve of the number buried every 5 min.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖距珠子边缘 ≤ 设定距离（默认 1 cm）的次数、时间、首次潜伏期和接近过的珠子数。
measures.def_en: Nose within the set distance of a marble's edge (1 cm by default): count, time, latency to the first approach and the number of marbles approached.

refs.citation: Deacon RMJ (2006) Digging and marble burying in mice: simple methods for in vivo identification of biological impacts. Nat Protoc 1:122–124.
Thomas A, Burant A, Bui N, Graham D, Yuva-Paylor LA, Paylor R (2009) Marble burying reflects a repetitive and perseverative behavior more than novelty-induced anxiety. Psychopharmacology 204:361–373.
Angoa-Pérez M, Kane MJ, Briggs DI, Francescutti DM, Kuhn DM (2013) Marble burying and nestlet shredding as tests of repetitive, compulsive-like behaviors in mice. J Vis Exp 82:50978.

Wahl L, Punt AM, Arbab T, Willuhn I, Elgersma Y, Badura A (2022) A novel automated approach for improving standardization of the marble burying test enables quantification of burying bouts and activity characteristics. eNeuro 9:ENEURO.0446-21.2022.

marbleBurying.tagline_en: Marbles buried (from how much each marble is covered) · burying events · marble approaches
marbleBurying.summary_en: Twenty glass marbles are laid out on about 5 cm of flattened bedding and the mouse is left alone for 30 min (15 or 20 min in some protocols); at the end the marbles buried by bedding are counted (usual criterion: ≥ 2/3 covered). It is widely used to study compulsive-like and repetitive digging behavior and to screen anxiolytic drugs, but what it actually measures is still debated. RodentFlow reads from the video how much each marble is covered, sampling only after the mouse has left it (using the tracking), so it gives when each marble was buried, plus the number and duration of marble approaches.
marbleBurying.whyPose_en: Whether a marble is covered can only be seen while the mouse is not blocking it. RodentFlow uses the mouse's keypoints (including the tail position extrapolated along the body axis) to tell which marbles are not blocked at a given moment and have been left by the mouse for at least 1 s, and reads the marbles' covered fraction only from those frames; the same keypoints also give the number and duration of nose approaches to each marble.

stepDown.tagline: 下台潜伏期（截尾）· 平台上僵直 · 边缘探头
stepDown.summary: 小鼠被放在电网中央的小平台上。训练时四爪都踏到电网即给足底电击；间隔一段时间（常为 24 h）后再放回平台，测下台潜伏期，截止时间常为 180 或 300 s。潜伏期越长，表示越记得下台与电击的关联；测试 / 训练潜伏期之比可作为记忆保持指数。
stepDown.whyPose: “下台”要四爪落到电网上，RodentFlow 默认用身体中心和尾根都离开平台来近似；身体还在平台上、只把鼻尖伸出边缘的探头单独计数，作为下台前的风险评估。
setup_zh: 标定整个箱底，把 P 手柄拖到平台中心，在参数里输入平台的宽和高
“分析起点”设为把小鼠放上平台的时刻，“分析时长”设为截止时间（常用 180 或 300 s）
训练和测试分别建立分析，编号相同时测试会自动和训练配对
setup_en: Calibrate the whole box floor, drag the P handle onto the platform center and enter the platform's width and height in the parameters
Set the analysis start to the moment the mouse is placed on the platform and the analysis length to the cut-off (typically 180 or 300 s)
Create separate analyses for training and test; a test is paired with the training session automatically when the animal ID is the same

measures.def_zh: 按下台规则首次离开平台的时间；截止前没有下台时记为截止时间并标为未下台（右删失），组间页对它做生存分析。测试阶段另给测试 / 训练潜伏期之比（同一编号自动配对）。
measures.def_en: Time of the first step-down from the platform by the step-down rule; without a step-down before the cut-off it is the cut-off and flagged as no step-down (right-censored), with a survival analysis on the group page. In the test phase the test / training latency ratio is also given (paired automatically by animal ID).

measures.def_zh: 截止前是否下台（0 / 100），以及下台次数和平台上的时间。
measures.def_en: Whether the animal stepped down before the cut-off (0 / 100), plus the number of step-downs and the time on the platform.

measures.def_zh: 在平台上时的僵直比例（同恐惧条件化的定义）。
measures.def_en: Percentage of the time on the platform spent freezing (same definition as fear conditioning).

measures.def_zh: 身体中心和尾根仍在平台上、鼻尖伸出平台边缘，持续 ≥ 设定时长：次数、下台前次数、首次探头潜伏期。
measures.def_en: The nose beyond the platform edge while the body center and tail base stay on the platform for ≥ the set time: count, count before the step-down, latency to the first dip.

refs.citation: Kameyama T, Nabeshima T, Kozawa T (1986) Step-down-type passive avoidance- and escape-learning method: suitability for experimental amnesia models. J Pharmacol Methods 16:39–52.
Kaplan EL, Meier P (1958) Nonparametric estimation from incomplete observations. J Am Stat Assoc 53:457–481.

stepDown.tagline_en: Censored step-down latency · freezing on the platform · edge head dips
stepDown.summary_en: The mouse is placed on a small platform in the middle of a grid floor. In training it receives a foot shock as soon as all four paws touch the grid; after a delay (often 24 h) it is placed on the platform again and the step-down latency is measured, usually with a 180- or 300-s cut-off. A longer latency means better memory of the step-down–shock association; the test / training latency ratio can serve as a retention index.
stepDown.whyPose_en: A step-down means all four paws on the grid; by default RodentFlow approximates it as both the body center and the tail base leaving the platform. Head dips with the body still on the platform and only the nose beyond the edge are counted separately, as risk assessment before the step-down.

platformAvoidance.tagline: 平台时间 · 上平台潜伏期 · 平台上 / 外僵直
platformAvoidance.summary: 小鼠先学会声音预示足底电击，再学会走到场地一角的安全平台上躲开电击（电击在声音的最后 2 s）；在电击前上平台并待到电击结束即成功回避，代价是离开奖励口。声音、电击和奖励由各自的设备控制和记录；RodentFlow 给出追踪能算的部分：平台时间、上平台次数和潜伏期、平台上和平台外的僵直，以及逐帧的“在平台上”标记，可按设备记录的声音时间自行切分每个试次。
platformAvoidance.whyPose: 文献中“在平台上”常按至少两爪在平台上计。RodentFlow 可按身体中心、鼻尖 + 颈部（近似两前爪）或身体中心 + 尾根（近似四爪）判断；僵直用多个关键点的运动指数，头部的小动作不会被当成运动。
setup_zh: 标定场地四角，输入内部尺寸
把 P 手柄拖到平台中心，在参数里输入平台的宽和高
需要奖励口区时在参数里打开，再把 R 手柄拖到奖励口
逐帧 CSV 的 on_platform、freezing 列用视频时间，可按设备记录的声音时间自行切分每个试次
setup_en: Calibrate the four corners of the arena and enter the inside dimensions
Drag the P handle onto the platform center and enter the platform's width and height in the parameters
For a reward-port zone, turn it on in the parameters and drag the R handle onto the reward port
The on_platform and freezing columns of the frame-by-frame CSV are in video time; cut each trial yourself with the tone times from the device log

measures.def_zh: 按上平台规则在平台上的时间（s、%），上平台次数、首次上平台潜伏期、平均每次停留时长。
measures.def_en: Time on the platform by the on-platform rule (s, %), platform entries, latency to the first entry and mean duration per visit.

measures.def_zh: 运动指数低于阈值并持续 ≥ 最短时长（同恐惧条件化）；另给平台上和平台外各自的僵直比例。
measures.def_en: Motion index below the threshold for ≥ the minimum duration (as in fear conditioning); freezing percentages on and off the platform are also given.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖在奖励口半径内的时间和次数（可选）。
measures.def_en: Time and entries with the nose within the reward-port radius (optional).

measures.def_zh: 每段时间的平台时间 % 和僵直 %，组间页可做时间进程。
measures.def_en: Percentage of time on the platform and freezing per time bin; the group page can plot the time course.

refs.citation: Bravo-Rivera C, Roman-Ortiz C, Brignoni-Perez E, Sotres-Bayon F, Quirk GJ (2014) Neural structures mediating expression and extinction of platform-mediated avoidance. J Neurosci 34:9736–9742.

Diehl MM, Iravedra-Garcia JM, Morán-Sierra J, Rojas-Bowe G, Gonzalez-Diaz FN, Valentín-Valentín VP, Quirk GJ (2020) Divergent projections of the prelimbic cortex bidirectionally regulate active avoidance. eLife 9:e59281.

platformAvoidance.tagline_en: Time on the platform · latency to the platform · freezing on / off the platform
platformAvoidance.summary_en: The mouse first learns that a tone predicts a foot shock, then learns to step onto a safe platform in one corner of the arena to avoid the shock (delivered in the last 2 s of the tone); getting onto the platform before the shock and staying there until it ends is a successful avoidance, at the cost of leaving the reward port. Tones, shocks and rewards are controlled and logged by their own devices; RodentFlow provides what the tracking can measure: time on the platform, platform entries and latency, freezing on and off the platform, and a frame-by-frame “on the platform” flag, so you can cut each trial yourself with the tone times from the device log.
platformAvoidance.whyPose_en: In the literature, “on the platform” usually means at least two paws on the platform. RodentFlow can judge it by the body center, nose + neck (approximating both forepaws) or body center + tail base (approximating all four paws); freezing uses a motion index over several keypoints, so small head movements are not counted as movement.

novelObject.tagline: 鼻尖距离 + 朝向判定探索 · 辨别指数
novelObject.summary: 训练期探索两个相同物体，间隔一段时间后把其中一个换成新物体。啮齿类天生偏好新物体，辨别指数 DI 反映识别记忆。移动物体位置即为物体位置记忆（OLM）。
novelObject.whyPose: 公认的“探索”定义是鼻尖距物体 ≤ 2 cm 且头朝向物体，爬到物体上或背对物体坐着都不算。质心半径法会把路过和坐在旁边也算进去。
setup_zh: 把 A / B 手柄拖到两个物体中心，设置物体半径
测试阶段选择哪个是新物体
setup_en: Drag A / B handles to object centers and set the object radius.
Specify which object is novel in the test phase.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖在物体外缘 2 cm 以内、头朝向物体（±45°），且身体中心不在物体上。
measures.def_en: Nose within 2 cm of the object edge, oriented toward it (±45°), with body center off the object.

measures.def_zh: (新 − 旧) ÷ (新 + 旧)；训练阶段为 (B − A) ÷ (B + A)，用来检查位置偏好。
measures.def_en: (Novel − familiar) / (novel + familiar); the training phase uses (B − A) / (B + A) for side bias.
Novel / (novel + familiar) × 100%.

measures.def_zh: 累计探索达到 20 s 的时间，以及达到时的 DI。
measures.def_en: Time to 20 s cumulative investigation and DI at that point.

refs.citation: Ennaceur A, Delacour J (1988) A new one-trial test for neurobiological studies of memory in rats. 1: Behavioral data. Behav Brain Res 31:47–59.
Leger M et al. (2013) Object recognition test in mice. Nat Protoc 8:2531–2537.
Gabriel CJ et al. (2022) BehaviorDEPOT is a simple, flexible tool for automated behavioral detection based on markerless pose tracking. eLife 11:e74314.

novelObject.tagline_en: Nose distance and orientation · Discrimination index
novelObject.summary_en: In training, animals investigate two identical objects; after a delay, one is replaced with a novel object. Novelty preference is summarized by the discrimination index (DI). Changing an object's position instead tests object-location memory (OLM).
novelObject.whyPose_en: A common operational definition of object investigation requires the nose to be within 2 cm of the object and facing it, excluding climbing or sitting beside it. A centroid-radius approach can overcount passing or nearby inactivity.

barnesMaze.tagline: 以鼻尖探洞计错误数 · 潜伏期与路径
barnesMaze.summary: 圆形平台边缘有一圈洞，只有目标洞下有逃逸箱。动物借助墙上的空间线索学习目标位置。读数为找到目标洞的潜伏期、错误数和路径长度；探索测试中看目标象限时间。
barnesMaze.whyPose: Barnes 迷宫的“错误”定义是把鼻子探进非目标洞，这是鼻尖行为，质心追踪无法计数。
setup_zh: 拖动 C（中心）和 R（边缘）标定平台
把 T 手柄拖到目标洞中心；其余洞按数量均匀排列
setup_en: Calibrate the platform with C (center) and R (edge).
Place T at the target hole; other holes are placed evenly according to the hole count.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖首次探入目标洞的时间。
measures.def_en: Time until the nose first enters the target hole.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖探入非目标洞的次数：首次找到目标前的为首次错误，全程的为总错误。
measures.def_en: Nose probes into non-target holes; initial errors precede target discovery and total errors cover the full session.

measures.def_zh: 首次找到目标洞之前身体中心的移动距离。
measures.def_en: Body-center path length before first target-hole discovery.

measures.def_zh: 以目标洞为中心 ±45° 扇区内的时间比例（探索测试）。
measures.def_en: Fraction of time in the ±45° sector centered on the target hole (probe trial).

refs.citation: Barnes CA (1979) Memory deficits associated with senescence: a neurophysiological and behavioral study in the rat. J Comp Physiol Psychol 93:74–104.
Pitts MW (2018) Barnes maze procedure for spatial learning and memory in mice. Bio-protocol 8:e2744.

barnesMaze.tagline_en: Nose-based hole investigation · Errors, latency and path
barnesMaze.summary_en: The Barnes maze has a ring of holes, with an escape box under the target hole. Animals learn its location using distal spatial cues. Metrics include target latency, errors, path length and target-quadrant time in probe trials.
barnesMaze.whyPose_en: In the Barnes maze, an error is a nose probe into a non-target hole. This is a nose-specific behavior that centroid tracking cannot reliably count.

waterMaze.tagline: 逃避潜伏期、路径与搜索策略 · 探索测试看平均距离与象限
waterMaze.summary: 小鼠在注满不透明水的圆形水池中游泳，借助池外的空间线索寻找水面下的隐藏平台。学习期看逃避潜伏期、路径长度和搜索策略的进步；探索测试撤去平台，看小鼠是否集中在原平台附近搜索（平均距原平台距离、目标象限时间、穿越次数）。可见平台试次用来排除视觉和运动问题。
waterMaze.whyPose: 与旷场相同的逐帧关键点识别，数据处理换成水迷宫的指标。身体中心比质心更稳定（不受尾巴和水花影响）；头朝向可以直接给出入水时是否朝向平台。游泳时尾根常在水下，RodentFlow 用身体中心，缺失时退回到两耳中点或鼻尖；每个试次按 Pathfinder 的规则判定搜索策略。
setup_zh: 拖动 C（中心）和 R（池壁）标定水池，输入水池内径
把 P 手柄拖到平台中心；探索测试时放在原平台位置
在参数里把“分析起点”设为小鼠入水的时刻，“分析时长”设为最长试次时间（如 60 s）
水面反光、池边的实验者等固定干扰，可先用“视频遮挡”盖住再分析
setup_en: Drag C (center) and R (wall) to calibrate the pool and enter its inner diameter
Drag the P handle onto the platform center; in the probe test, onto the former platform location
In the parameters, set the analysis start to the moment of release and the analysis length to the maximum trial time (e.g. 60 s)
Fixed distractions such as reflections on the water or the experimenter at the pool edge can be covered first with “Cover part of a video”

measures.def_zh: 身体中心进入平台（半径 + 余量）并停留 ≥ 设定时长的时刻；没找到时记为试次时长。
measures.def_en: When the body center enters the platform (radius + margin) and stays for the set time; the trial length if the platform is not found.

measures.def_zh: 入水到找到平台之间身体中心的路程、平均游速和路径效率（直线距离 ÷ 实际路程）。
measures.def_en: Body-center path from release to the platform, mean swim speed and path efficiency (straight-line distance ÷ actual path).

measures.name_zh: 平均距离与累计搜索误差
measures.name_en: Mean proximity and cumulative search error
measures.def_zh: 到平台中心的平均距离（Gallagher）；按 1 s 分段累加的距离减去以同样速度直线游向平台的理想值（CIPL）。
measures.def_en: Mean distance to the platform center (Gallagher); the sum of 1-s distances minus the ideal straight swim at the same speed (CIPL).

measures.def_zh: 目标、对侧和两个相邻象限的时间比例，平台区时间；探索测试另给穿越原平台次数、前 30 s 和分段的目标象限时间、搜索熵。
measures.def_en: Time in the target, opposite and two adjacent quadrants and in the platform zone; the probe test adds crossings, target quadrant time in the first 30 s and per bin, and the search entropy.

measures.def_zh: Pathfinder 规则：直线路径、聚焦、定向、间接、链式、扫描、贴壁、随机；附认知评分（0–6）。
measures.def_en: Pathfinder rules: direct path, focal, directed, indirect, chaining, scanning, thigmotaxis, random; with a cognitive score (0–6).

measures.def_zh: 距池壁不超过贴壁区宽度的时间；速度 < 2 cm/s 持续 ≥ 1 s 的漂浮时间。两者都是非认知因素。
measures.def_en: Time within the thigmotaxis zone width of the wall; floating = speed < 2 cm/s for ≥ 1 s. Both are non-cognitive factors.

refs.citation: Morris R (1984) Developments of a water-maze procedure for studying spatial learning in the rat. J Neurosci Methods 11:47–60.
Vorhees CV, Williams MT (2006) Morris water maze: procedures for assessing spatial and related forms of learning and memory. Nat Protoc 1:848–858.
Gallagher M, Burwell R, Burchinal M (1993) Severity of spatial learning impairment in aging: development of a learning index for performance in the Morris water maze. Behav Neurosci 107:618–626.
Maei HR, Zaslavsky K, Teixeira CM, Frankland PW (2009) What is the most sensitive measure of water maze probe test performance? Front Integr Neurosci 3:4.
Maei HR et al. (2009) Development and validation of a sensitive entropy-based measure for the water maze. Front Integr Neurosci 3:33.
Cooke MB, O'Leary TP, Harris P, Ma R, Brown RE, Snyder JS (2019) Pathfinder: open source software for analyzing spatial navigation search strategies. F1000Research 8:1521.
Garthe A, Behr J, Kempermann G (2009) Adult-generated hippocampal neurons allow the flexible use of spatially precise learning strategies. PLoS One 4:e5464.
Wolfer DP, Stagljar-Bozicevic M, Errington ML, Lipp HP (1998) Spatial memory and learning in transgenic mice: fact or artifact? News Physiol Sci 13:118–123.

waterMaze.tagline_en: Escape latency, path and search strategy · mean proximity and quadrants in the probe
waterMaze.summary_en: The mouse swims in a circular pool of opaque water and uses distal room cues to find a hidden platform below the surface. Acquisition is followed by the escape latency, path length and search strategy; in the probe test the platform is removed and the search near its former location is measured (mean proximity, target quadrant time, crossings). Visible-platform trials rule out visual or motor problems.
waterMaze.whyPose_en: The same frame-by-frame keypoint tracking as the open field, with water-maze data processing. The body center is steadier than a centroid (not moved by the tail or splashes), and head direction shows directly whether the mouse faces the platform after release. The tail base is often under water while swimming, so RodentFlow uses the body center and falls back to the ear midpoint or nose; each trial gets a Pathfinder-style strategy call.

passiveAvoidance.tagline: 进入暗室潜伏期（截尾）· 反向探头风险评估
passiveAvoidance.summary: 明暗两室之间有门。训练时小鼠一进入暗室就给足底电击；间隔一段时间（常为 24 h）后再放回明室，测进入暗室的潜伏期，截止时间常为 300 s。潜伏期越长，表示越记得暗室与电击的关联。
passiveAvoidance.whyPose: 身体留在明室、只把鼻尖伸进暗室再退回，是测试期典型的风险评估，只有把鼻尖和身体分开判断才能计数。进入暗室可按身体中心、身体中心 + 尾根（近似四爪进入）或鼻尖判定。
setup_zh: 标定整个箱体，再设置明室所在侧和所占比例
把“分析起点”设为放入明室（或开门）的时刻，“分析时长”设为截止时间（常用 300 s）
训练和测试分别建立分析；组间页对潜伏期自动给出生存分析
setup_en: Calibrate the whole box, then set the side and share of the light compartment
Set the analysis start to the moment the mouse is placed in the light side (or the door opens), and the analysis length to the cut-off (typically 300 s)
Create separate analyses for training and test; the group page adds a survival analysis of the latency

measures.name_en: Latency to enter the dark side
measures.def_zh: 按进入规则首次进入暗室的时间；截止前没有进入时记为截止时间并标为未进入（右删失），组间页对它做生存分析。
measures.def_en: Time of the first entry into the dark side by the entry rule; without an entry before the cut-off it is the cut-off and flagged as not entered (right-censored), with a survival analysis on the group page.

measures.def_zh: 截止前是否进入（0 / 100），组平均即进入的比例。
measures.def_en: Whether the animal entered before the cut-off (0 / 100); the group mean is the percentage that entered.

measures.def_zh: 按同一进入规则统计。
measures.def_en: Counted with the same entry rule.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖伸进暗室而身体中心和尾根仍在明室，持续 ≥ 设定时长：次数、进入前次数、首次探头潜伏期。
measures.def_en: The nose in the dark side while the body center and tail base stay in the light for ≥ the set time: count, count before entry, latency to the first probe.

refs.citation: Jarvik ME, Kopp R (1967) An improved one-trial passive avoidance learning situation. Psychol Rep 21:221–224.
Kaplan EL, Meier P (1958) Nonparametric estimation from incomplete observations. J Am Stat Assoc 53:457–481.

passiveAvoidance.tagline_en: Censored latency to the dark side · reverse-probe risk assessment
passiveAvoidance.summary_en: A light and a dark compartment are joined by a door. In training the mouse receives a foot shock as soon as it enters the dark side; after a delay (often 24 h) it is placed in the light side again and the latency to enter the dark side is measured, usually with a 300-s cut-off. A longer latency means better memory of the dark side–shock association.
passiveAvoidance.whyPose_en: Keeping the body in the light side and only poking the nose into the dark side is typical risk assessment in the test; it can only be counted when the nose and the body are judged separately. Entry can be judged by the body center, body center + tail base (approximately four-paw entry) or the nose.

placePreference.tagline: 配对侧时间与偏好分数 · 前后测自动配对
placePreference.summary: 实时位置偏好（RTPP）：动物在两侧之间自由活动，进入其中一侧即给予刺激（如光遗传），测对该侧的偏好或回避。条件性位置偏好（CPP）：前测 → 一侧与药物或奖赏配对的条件化 → 后测，比较后测与前测在配对侧的时间。
placePreference.whyPose: 所在侧按身体中心判断，可要求尾根也越过分界线，卡在门口时不会来回误计穿越；后测自动与同一只动物的前测配对，直接给出 CPP 分数。
setup_zh: 标定整个装置，在参数里选择配对 / 刺激侧和分界位置
两侧之间有中间区时，在参数里打开“中间区”并设置宽度
CPP：前测和后测分别建立分析，动物编号相同即自动配对
setup_en: Calibrate the whole apparatus and choose the paired / stimulated side and the divider position in the parameters
With a middle compartment, turn on “Middle zone” in the parameters and set its width
CPP: create separate pre-test and post-test analyses; the same animal ID pairs them automatically

measures.def_zh: 身体中心在配对 / 刺激侧的时间（s、%），以及非配对侧和中间区的时间。
measures.def_en: Time with the body center on the paired / stimulated side (s, %), and on the unpaired side and in the middle zone.

measures.def_zh: 配对侧 − 非配对侧（s）；偏好指数 = (配对 − 非配对) ÷ (配对 + 非配对)。
measures.def_en: Paired − unpaired side (s); preference index = (paired − unpaired) ÷ (paired + unpaired).

measures.def_zh: 后测配对侧时间 − 前测配对侧时间（同一编号自动配对）。
measures.def_en: Post-test paired side time − pre-test paired side time (paired automatically by animal ID).

measures.def_zh: 两侧之间的穿越次数、首次进入配对侧潜伏期、分段配对侧时间。
measures.def_en: Crossings between the sides, latency to the paired side, paired side time per bin.

refs.citation: Tzschentke TM (2007) Measuring reward with the conditioned place preference (CPP) paradigm: update of the last decade. Addict Biol 12:227–462.
Stamatakis AM, Stuber GD (2012) Activation of lateral habenula inputs to the ventral midbrain promotes behavioral avoidance. Nat Neurosci 15:1105–1107.

placePreference.tagline_en: Paired side time and preference score · automatic pre / post pairing
placePreference.summary_en: Real-time place preference (RTPP): the animal moves freely between two sides and is stimulated (e.g. optogenetically) whenever it is on one of them; preference for or avoidance of that side is measured. Conditioned place preference (CPP): pre-test → conditioning that pairs one side with a drug or reward → post-test, comparing paired-side time between post- and pre-test.
placePreference.whyPose_en: The side is judged by the body center, optionally also requiring the tail base across the divider, so an animal in the doorway is not counted as crossing back and forth; a post-test is paired with the same animal's pre-test automatically and gives the CPP score directly.

yMaze.title: Y 迷宫
yMaze.tagline: 工作记忆 · 交替率与探头未进入
yMaze.summary: 三条臂互成 120°，动物自由探索约 8 min。连续三次进入三条不同的臂记为一次交替，交替率 = 交替次数 ÷（总进入次数 − 2）。
yMaze.whyPose: 标准规定四爪都进入臂才算一次进入。RodentFlow 默认要求身体中心和尾根都在臂内（近似四爪进入），并单独统计“只探头、未进入”。
setup_zh: J 为三臂交汇中心，A / B / C 为三个臂末端
输入臂长和臂宽（cm）
setup_en: J marks the junction; A / B / C mark the three arm tips.
Enter arm length and width (cm).

measures.def_zh: 连续三次进入三条不同臂的次数 ÷（总进入次数 − 2）。
measures.def_en: Number of three-entry sequences visiting distinct arms / (total entries − 2).

measures.def_zh: 默认身体中心和尾根都在臂内才算一次进入。
measures.def_en: By default an entry requires both body center and tail base to be inside the arm.

measures.def_zh: 鼻尖进入某臂但身体没有进入就退回。
measures.def_en: Nose enters an arm but the body turns back before entry.

refs.citation: Hughes RN (2004) The value of spontaneous alternation behavior (SAB) as a test of retention in pharmacological investigations of memory. Neurosci Biobehav Rev 28:497–505.
Kraeuter AK, Guest PC, Sarnyai Z (2019) The Y-maze for assessment of spatial working and reference memory in mice. Methods Mol Biol 1916:105–111.

yMaze.tagline_en: Working memory · Alternation and partial entries
yMaze.summary_en: Three arms meet at 120°. The animal explores freely for about 8 minutes. Visiting all three arms in three successive entries counts as an alternation; alternation rate is alternations / (entries − 2).
yMaze.whyPose_en: Many scoring protocols require all four paws inside an arm to count an entry. RodentFlow approximates this using body center and tail base, and separately reports head-only entries.

tMaze.title: T 迷宫
tMaze.tagline: 选择点头部扫视（替代性试错）
tMaze.summary: 动物在选择点停下，头部在两侧之间来回摆动，称为替代性试错（VTE），反映决策时的权衡。经典量化方法是通过选择点时朝向的累计绝对变化 IdPhi，并在每次会话内做 z 标准化。
tMaze.whyPose: VTE 本质是头部扫视。RodentFlow 直接用头朝向计算 IdPhi，同时给出基于运动轨迹方向的 IdPhi 作为对照，并统计左右选择与交替。
setup_zh: J 为选择点，S 为起始臂末端，L / R 为左右臂末端
setup_en: J marks the choice point, S the start arm, and L / R the left and right arms.

measures.def_zh: 每次从起始臂经过选择点进入左 / 右臂期间，头朝向变化绝对值的累计（°）。
measures.def_en: Cumulative absolute change in head direction (°) while passing the decision point into left or right arm.

measures.def_zh: 会话内 z 标准化；zIdPhi ≥ 0.5 记为 VTE（阈值可调）。
measures.def_en: Within-session z-scoring; zIdPhi ≥ 0.5 is classified as VTE (adjustable).

measures.def_zh: 左 / 右选择、连续选择的交替率、选择点停留时间。
measures.def_en: Left/right choice, alternation rate and time spent at the choice point.

refs.citation: Redish AD (2016) Vicarious trial and error. Nat Rev Neurosci 17:147–159.
Deacon RMJ, Rawlins JNP (2006) T-maze alternation in the rodent. Nat Protoc 1:7–12.
Gabriel CJ et al. (2022) BehaviorDEPOT (VTE module). eLife 11:e74314.

tMaze.tagline_en: Head scanning at the decision point (VTE)
tMaze.summary_en: At choice points, animals sometimes pause and scan between alternatives, a behavior known as vicarious trial and error (VTE). A common measure is IdPhi, the cumulative absolute change in orientation during the choice, z-scored within a session.
tMaze.whyPose_en: VTE involves head scanning. RodentFlow computes IdPhi from head direction and provides a trajectory-based IdPhi for comparison, together with left/right choices and alternation.

fearConditioning.tagline: 关键点僵直检测 · 按 CS 分段
fearConditioning.summary: 声音（CS）与足底电击配对后，在相同情境或新情境中重放 CS，测量僵直（除呼吸外完全不动）所占的百分比。
fearConditioning.whyPose: 运动像素法会把呼吸、光照闪烁和相机噪声也算进去。RodentFlow 用鼻尖、两耳中点、身体中心和尾根在 0.5 s 窗口内的位移速度判断僵直，头部的小动作（嗅探、扫视）不会被误判为僵直。
setup_zh: 在参数里输入 CS 开始时间（相对于视频开头）和时长
红外或灰度视频效果最好
setup_en: Enter CS onset times (relative to video start) and durations.
Infrared or grayscale recordings work best.

measures.def_zh: 核心关键点 0.5 s 窗口位移速度 < 1.0 cm/s，持续 ≥ 1 s。
measures.def_en: Core keypoint displacement speed < 1.0 cm/s in a 0.5 s window for ≥ 1 s.

measures.def_zh: 基线（首个 CS 前）、每个 CS 期间、CS 间隔的僵直百分比。
measures.def_en: Freezing percentages before first CS, during each CS, and between CS events.

measures.def_zh: 每分钟僵直百分比。
measures.def_en: Freezing fraction per minute.

refs.citation: Phillips RG, LeDoux JE (1992) Differential contribution of amygdala and hippocampus to cued and contextual fear conditioning. Behav Neurosci 106:274–285.
Anagnostaras SG et al. (2010) Automated assessment of Pavlovian conditioned freezing and shock reactivity in mice using the Video Freeze system. Front Behav Neurosci 4:158.
Gabriel CJ et al. (2022) BehaviorDEPOT (freezing from keypoints). eLife 11:e74314.

fearConditioning.summary_en: Following pairing of an auditory conditioned stimulus (CS) with footshock, the CS is replayed in the original or a new context to quantify freezing (immobility except breathing).
fearConditioning.whyPose_en: Pixel-motion methods may be confounded by breathing, flicker and camera noise. RodentFlow uses displacement speeds of nose, ear midpoint, body center and tail base in a 0.5 s window; small head movements can prevent false freezing calls.

looming.tagline: 头顶扩张黑影 → 逃回巢穴或僵直
looming.summary: 动物头顶的屏幕呈现快速扩大的黑色圆盘（模拟俯冲的捕食者），小鼠通常在一秒内逃回庇护所或原地僵直。读数是反应潜伏期、是否逃回巢穴、逃跑速度和僵直。
looming.whyPose: 刺激出现时的头朝向和到巢穴的方向决定了逃跑路径，是这个范式的重要协变量。RodentFlow 给出每次刺激时头部与巢穴方向的夹角。
setup_zh: 把 S 手柄拖到巢穴（庇护所）中心
输入每次刺激出现的时间（相对于视频开头）
需要威胁区（刺激下方的区域）时在参数里打开，再把 T 手柄拖到区域中心
setup_en: Drag S to the center of the shelter.
Enter each stimulus onset time relative to video start.
For a threat zone (the area under the stimulus), turn it on in the parameters and drag the T handle onto its center

measures.def_zh: 刺激后速度首次超过 max(4 × 基线速度, 15 cm/s) 的时间。
measures.def_en: Time until speed first exceeds max(4× baseline speed, 15 cm/s) after stimulus.

measures.def_zh: 有反应且在 10 s 内回到巢穴区。
measures.def_en: Behavioral response followed by return to shelter within 10 s.

measures.def_zh: 刺激后 10 s 内的僵直时长（同恐惧条件化的定义）。
measures.def_en: Freezing duration during 10 s after stimulus (same definition as fear conditioning).

measures.def_zh: 刺激时头朝向与巢穴方向的夹角、到巢穴的距离。
measures.def_en: Angle between head direction and shelter direction at stimulation, plus distance to shelter.

measures.def_zh: 僵直可用运动指数（同恐惧条件化），或按 De Franceschi 等（2016）用身体速度 < 2 cm/s 持续 ≥ 0.5 s；可选的威胁区给出区内时间，并在逐帧数据中标记。
measures.def_en: Freezing can use the motion index (as in fear conditioning) or, following De Franceschi et al. (2016), body speed < 2 cm/s for ≥ 0.5 s; the optional threat zone gives the time spent in it and is flagged in the frame-by-frame data.

refs.citation: Yilmaz M, Meister M (2013) Rapid innate defensive responses of mice to looming visual stimuli. Curr Biol 23:2011–2015.
Vale R, Evans DA, Branco T (2017) Rapid spatial learning controls instinctive defensive behavior in mice. Curr Biol 27:1342–1349.
De Franceschi G, Vivattanasarn T, Saleem AB, Solomon SG (2016) Vision guides selection of freeze or flight defense strategies in mice. Curr Biol 26:2150–2154.

looming.tagline_en: Overhead expanding shadow → Escape or freezing
looming.summary_en: A rapidly expanding dark disk overhead mimics an approaching predator and can evoke rapid shelter-directed escape or freezing. Metrics include response latency, shelter return, escape speed and freezing.
looming.whyPose_en: Head direction relative to shelter at stimulus onset can influence escape paths. RodentFlow reports the head-to-shelter angle for each stimulus.

rotation.tagline: 单侧损伤模型 · 同侧 / 对侧整圈数
rotation.summary: 单侧损伤或其他单侧操作后，动物常表现出偏向一侧的旋转。按身体轴向统计同侧与对侧整圈数，净旋转数用于量化左右不对称的程度，或比较不同实验条件。
rotation.whyPose: 旋转计数需要身体轴向（尾根 → 颈部）。RodentFlow 对轴向角度累计计数完整的 360° 转圈，原地小转也能计入，不需要旋转计。
setup_zh: 选择损伤侧别；从透明底部仰拍时请打开“从下方拍摄”
每 5 min 分段统计
实验条件可在“信息”页用 + 添加为自定义标签
setup_en: Set the lesion side; enable “Filmed from below” if recorded through a transparent floor.
Report results in 5-minute bins.
Add experimental conditions as your own labels with + on the Info step

measures.def_zh: 身体轴向（尾根 → 颈部）累计转过 360° 记一圈，顺 / 逆时针分开；反向回转超过 90° 时重新计数。
measures.def_en: One complete 360° turn from body heading; clockwise and counterclockwise counted separately, restarting after > 90° reversal.

measures.def_zh: 根据损伤侧别换算；俯拍时画面逆时针 = 动物向左转。
measures.def_en: Adjusted for lesion side; overhead video counterclockwise corresponds to animal left turns.

measures.def_zh: 同侧 − 对侧，及每分钟净旋转数和分段曲线。
measures.def_en: Ipsilateral − contralateral rotations, net turns per minute and binned trends.

refs.citation: Pycock CJ (1980) Turning behaviour in animals. Neuroscience 5:461–514.

rotation.tagline_en: Unilateral lesion models · Ipsilateral / contralateral full turns
rotation.summary_en: After a unilateral lesion or another one-sided manipulation, animals often turn preferentially toward one side. Full ipsilateral and contralateral turns are counted from the body axis; net rotations quantify the left–right asymmetry or compare experimental conditions.
rotation.whyPose_en: Counting rotations needs body heading (tail base → neck). RodentFlow accumulates complete 360° turns, including small in-place turns, without a rotometer.

poseOnly.tagline: 逐帧 6 个关键点 + 运动学 · 自定义分析
poseOnly.summary: 不做范式分析，只输出逐帧关键点和派生运动学（速度、头朝向、身体轴向等），用于自己的分析流程（如 Keypoint-MoSeq、B-SOiD、SimBA）。
poseOnly.whyPose: 保留原始逐帧关键点（像素坐标、置信度），同时附带标定后的厘米坐标和派生特征。
setup_zh: 不标定时坐标为像素；标定后额外输出厘米坐标
setup_en: Without calibration, coordinates are pixels; calibration also provides centimeter coordinates.

measures.def_zh: 6 个关键点的像素坐标与置信度（与旧版 CSV 格式一致）。
measures.def_en: Pixel coordinates and confidence for six keypoints (backward-compatible CSV schema).

measures.def_zh: 平滑后的坐标、速度、头朝向、身体轴向、头–身夹角、身体长度。
measures.def_en: Smoothed coordinates, speed, head direction, body heading, head–body angle and body length.

measures.def_zh: 检出率、各关键点平均置信度。
measures.def_en: Detection rate and mean confidence for each keypoint.

refs.citation: Mathis A et al. (2018) DeepLabCut. Nat Neurosci 21:1281–1289.
Pereira TD et al. (2022) SLEAP: a deep learning system for multi-animal pose tracking. Nat Methods 19:486–495.
Weinreb C et al. (2024) Keypoint-MoSeq: parsing behavior by linking point tracking to pose dynamics. Nat Methods 21:1329–1339.

poseOnly.tagline_en: Six framewise keypoints and kinematics · Custom analysis
poseOnly.summary_en: Exports framewise keypoints and derived kinematics (speed, head direction, body axis, etc.) without assay-specific analysis, for custom workflows such as Keypoint-MoSeq, B-SOiD or SimBA.
poseOnly.whyPose_en: Retain raw framewise keypoints (pixel coordinates and confidence) alongside calibrated centimeter coordinates and derived features.

groupBehavior.tagline: 3–10 只深色小鼠 · 接触、聚集、最近邻距离、等级（预览）
groupBehavior.summary: 3–10 只小鼠在同一场地自由活动，不需要标记。读数是群体层面的接触比例、最近邻距离、聚集团大小和活动量，以及接近–回避事件和由它们算出的等级。
groupBehavior.whyPose: 接触和聚集由身体各部位之间的距离定义；接近–回避事件需要每只鼠的位置和运动方向。这些都来自 6 个关键点，贴身时比质心稳定。
setup_zh: 俯拍，整个场地在画面内，所有鼠都看得见；这一版只支持深色小鼠
建议逐帧识别，帧率 ≥ 25 fps
等级需要足够多的事件：每只鼠至少 10 次，最好 20 次，所以录像不要太短
编号可能在贴身时互换，也不对应具体动物：要把等级对应到具体动物，需要物理标记或 RFID
setup_en: Film from above with the whole arena in view and all mice visible; this version supports dark mice only
Process every frame, at 25 fps or more
A hierarchy needs enough events (at least 10 and ideally 20 per mouse), so do not make recordings too short
IDs can swap when mice touch and do not refer to specific animals: tying ranks to specific animals needs physical marks or RFID

measures.def_en: Fraction of time a mouse’s body is within 0.35 body lengths of another mouse’s body (mean of all mice).
measures.def_zh: 一只鼠的身体与其他鼠的身体距离 < 0.35 体长的时间比例（各鼠平均）。

measures.def_en: Mean distance from each mouse to the nearest other mouse (body centers).
measures.def_zh: 每只鼠到最近一只鼠的身体中心距离的平均。

measures.def_en: One mouse moves toward its nearest neighbour while that neighbour moves away along the same line, lasting ≥ 0.4 s.
measures.def_zh: 一只鼠朝最近的鼠移动，对方沿同一方向离开，持续 ≥ 0.4 s。

measures.def_en: David’s score and Elo from approach–avoid events (the approacher wins). Identities can swap when mice touch and do not refer to specific animals.
measures.def_zh: 由接近–回避事件（接近者为胜）计算 David’s score 和 Elo。贴身时编号可能互换，编号也不对应具体动物。

refs.citation: de Chaumont F et al. (2019) Real-time analysis of the behaviour of groups of mice via a depth-sensing camera and machine learning. Nat Biomed Eng 3:930–942.
Reinwald JR et al. Individual differences drive social hierarchies in male mouse societies. eLife 109354.
Gammell MP et al. (2003) David’s score: a more appropriate dominance ranking method than Clutton-Brock et al.’s index. Anim Behav 66:601–605.
Sánchez-Tójar A, Schroeder J, Farine DR (2018) A practical guide for inferring reliable dominance hierarchies and estimating their uncertainty. J Anim Ecol 87:594–608.

groupBehavior.tagline_en: 3–10 dark mice · contact, grouping, nearest-neighbour distance, rank (preview)
groupBehavior.summary_en: 3–10 mice move freely in one arena, without marks. The readouts are group-level contact, nearest-neighbour distance, group sizes and activity, plus approach–avoid events and a hierarchy computed from them.
groupBehavior.whyPose_en: Contact and grouping are defined from the distances between body parts; approach–avoid events need each mouse's position and direction of movement. All come from the 6 keypoints and hold up better than a centroid when mice touch.
more_en: **Body lengths, not centimetres.** Distances and speeds are in body lengths (BL: the median nose-to-tail-base distance of all mice in the video), so the arena does not need to be calibrated. Contact means the bodies (the nose–neck–centre–tail-base line of each mouse) come within 0.35 BL; a group is a set of mice joined by contacts (de Chaumont et al. 2019).

**The approach–avoid rule in full.** Over a 0.4 s window, one mouse moves faster than 0.6 BL/s toward its nearest neighbour ahead of it (cosine > 0.8), 0.3–2.5 BL away, and that mouse moves away along the same line (cosine > 0.5), also faster than 0.6 BL/s, for at least 0.4 s. A chase is the same event at higher speed: the approacher faster than 2.7 BL/s and the other faster than 2 BL/s. The rule comes from a long-term study of rat groups ([Nagy et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-72437-5)), scaled to body lengths; it has not yet been checked against manual scoring in mice.

**Also in the report.** Time alone (in contact with no other mouse), group spread (mean distance to the group’s centre), the largest group and the share of time at each size, time with all mice together, the share of mice moving (faster than 0.25 BL/s), distance per mouse, contacts per minute, nose-to-nose and anogenital contact, chases, and identity-risk events (two body centres closer than 0.5 BL). For the hierarchy: a win–loss matrix, normalised David’s score and Elo per ID (Elo starts at 1000, k = 100), linearity h′, triangle transitivity, directional consistency, steepness, and how well the ranks from the first and second half of the events agree. Contact over time and nearest-neighbour distance over time are drawn as curves, and approach–avoid events, chases and moments with all mice together appear as timelines in the review.

**Why ranks are a preview.** Without physical marks, IDs can swap when mice touch, and the swaps add up: in validation videos with 7–10 mice, about one pair swapped every 1–3 minutes. IDs also do not refer to particular animals. The group-level measures (contact, nearest-neighbour distance, group sizes) are hardly affected, because a swap moves no mouse. Anything per ID (the ranks, per-pair contact) depends on the IDs staying right; to tie ranks to specific animals you need marks or RFID.
more_zh: **以体长为单位**：距离和速度都以体长（BL，视频中所有鼠鼻尖到尾根距离的中位数）为单位，所以不需要标定场地。接触指两鼠身体（鼻尖–颈–身体中心–尾根折线）的最短距离 < 0.35 BL；聚集团是互相接触连成一片的鼠（de Chaumont et al., 2019）。

**接近–回避的完整规则**：在 0.4 s 窗口的速度下，一只鼠以 > 0.6 BL/s 的速度朝前方最近的鼠移动（余弦 > 0.8），间距 0.3–2.5 BL，对方沿同一方向离开（余弦 > 0.5），速度也 > 0.6 BL/s，持续 ≥ 0.4 s。追逐是速度更快的同类事件：接近者 > 2.7 BL/s，对方 > 2 BL/s。规则来自一项大鼠群体的长期追踪研究（[Nagy et al. 2024](https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-024-72437-5)），按体长换算，还没有在小鼠上用人工评分验证。

**报告里还有**：独处比例（不与任何鼠接触的时间）、群体分散度（各鼠到群体重心的平均距离）、最大聚集团大小及各大小所占的时间、全部聚在一起的时间、活动比例（速度 > 0.25 BL/s 的鼠所占比例）、每只鼠的路程、每分钟接触次数、鼻–鼻接触和肛殖区嗅探、追逐，以及身份风险事件（两鼠身体中心距离 < 0.5 BL）。等级部分有胜负矩阵、每个编号的标准化 David’s score 和 Elo（Elo 从 1000 开始，k = 100）、线性度 h′、三角传递性、方向一致性、陡度，以及前后半段事件算出的等级是否一致。接触比例和最近邻距离随时间的变化画成曲线；接近–回避、追逐和全部聚在一起的时刻在回看中以时间轴显示。
**为什么等级只是预览**：没有物理标记时，小鼠贴身会让编号互换，而且会累积：在 7–10 只鼠的验证视频中，大约每 1–3 分钟有一对鼠的编号互换。编号也不对应具体动物。群体层面的指标（接触、最近邻距离、聚集团）基本不受影响，因为互换编号并不移动任何一只鼠。按编号计算的结果（等级、成对接触）要求编号一直正确；要把等级对应到具体动物，需要物理标记或 RFID。
